# Steps to gather AWS Account information for the reporting tools v3

# Steps to gather AWS Account information for the reporting tools

Contact: Tim Gourley for questions [tim\.gourley@siemens\.com](mailto:bob.donovan@siemens.com) CC [benjamin\.collar@siemens\.com,](mailto:benjamin.collar@siemens.com) [shamsundar\.machale@siemens\.com](mailto:shamsundar.machale@siemens.com) 

## Purpose

A set of auditing programs have been constructed that can gather data from your AWS account and generate reports that can be used for review\. These reports can be used to review:

- Access to IAM and UAS Roles
- Inventory
- Security Hub
- Inspector Findings for ECR and EC2
- Trusted Advisor
- Costs

## High Level Steps

Follow the steps in this document for a single account\. 

If you have more than one account, then fill out a document for each account\.

## One\-time required activity: Information needed to organize your account into the program

Please fill out the table below with the information requested for one account\.

Item Needed

Description

Your answers

Team Name

The name of your team\. How does the organization refer to your team\.

Team purpose

What does your team do, build, support?

Name of the AWS administrator

The first and last name of the person who is the AWS Administrator

Name of the UAS Role administrator

The first and last name of the person who is the UAS Role Administrator

AWS Account ID

12\-digit AWS account ID

CSO Project name

Example: awspdproject323

Primary Region

The region where you typically log into first to get access into the account and review data

Example: us\-east1

Nickname for the account

We need a name that makes it easy for people who are reviewing the reports to determine which the purpose or owner of the account\. 

Examples:

TcX\_Pathfinder\_323

TcX\_Pathfinder\_25

TcX\_StormOps\_60

TcX\_DeployOps\_361

Do you have configurations in a single region or multiple regions?

Choices: \[Single, Multiple\]

If operating in multiple regions, list all the regions where you have data\.

Examples: 

us\-east\-1

us\-east\-2

us\-west\-1

us\-west\-2

ap\-south\-1

ca\-central\-1

eu\-west\-1

ap\-southeast\-1

Production or Non\-production account?

Choices \[Production, Non\-Production\]

## One\-time required activity: Steps to setup AWS Account access for the report tool to gather data

Description: This configuration will give the Auditing tools access to gather data for the reports\. The role will use read only access, therefore no data will be changed by the tool\. The tool will only “read” data and build spreadsheets\.

1. Login into the AWS Account as an administrator
2. Create a Role
	1. Under “Trusted entity type”, select “Custom trust policy”

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- 
	1. In the “Custom trust policy” text editor
		1. Remove the existing json text in the editor area
		2. Copy the JSON text directly below in this document and paste into the “Custom trust policy” editor area
		3. In the editor, replace the phrase YOUR\_ACCOUNT\_ID with the account ID for this account\. Example is shown in the screenshot below\.

\\{

    "Version": "2012\-10\-17",

    "Statement": \[

        \\{

            "Sid": "",

            "Effect": "Allow",

            "Principal": \\{

                "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::YOUR\_ACCOUNT\_ID:saml\-provider/WebkeyProvider"

            \\},

            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML",

            "Condition": \\{

                "StringEquals": \\{

                    "SAML:aud": [https://signin\.aws\.amazon\.com/saml](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fsignin.aws.amazon.com%2Fsaml&data=05%7C01%7Cbob.donovan%40siemens.com%7C2fabd0bb0699453973a308dba4170e00%7C38ae3bcd95794fd4addab42e1495d55a%7C1%7C0%7C638284191148616533%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=RMvIO%2FlxUHq2Wb75YLDwFAlPjWrrQBFUi9bC%2Brknex0%3D&reserved=0)

                \\}

            \\}

        \\},

        \\{

            "Sid": "",

            "Effect": "Allow",

            "Principal": \\{

                "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::637010435899:role/managed\-zeus\-prod\-management\_Auditor"

            \\},

            "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",

            "Condition": \\{

                "StringEquals": \\{

                    "sts:ExternalId": "iegdcshv3kiuixr0z5t6ej62n42ex8tp"

                \\}

            \\}

        \\}

    \]

\\}

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- 
	1. In the “Add Permissions” page, within the section title “Permissions policies”, add the “ReadOnlyAccess” policy

![](data:image/png;base64,)

When completed, it should look like this

![](data:image/png;base64,)

	1. In the “Name, review and create” page

## One\-time optional activity: Steps to setup UAS Role Access

Description: If these steps are performed, this would be used by auditor to test the reporting tool\. For example, during program execution to gather data from your account, the tool may not know how to handle a use case configured in your account\. If such issues occur, the auditor could use this UAS role to log into your account and investigate the use case, then adjust the program\.

1. Login to the AWS Admin tool
2. Add a new entry for
	1. [tim\.gourley@siemens\.com](mailto:bob.donovan@siemens.com)
	2. Set the “attribute value” to the role ARN created above\.

## Regular required activity \(quarterly\): Steps to export UAS Role data for the report to ingest

Description: Performing this step will export the UAS roles into a spreadsheet\. The spreadsheet will be ingested into the Access Review report so that during a review the users of the UAS roles will be included in the charts\.

1. Login into the UAS Role administrator page
	1. [https://go\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/uasboot/](https://go.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/uasboot/)
2. Click on the Config link\.
3. Navigate to the “Get IAM User Roles” option, type in the account ID and export to Excel
4. Select the “AWS  IAM Role ARN” in the “Attribute Name” field\. 
5. Provide the AWS account number

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. Click on the Search button to see results\.
2. Click “Download Excel” button to export results to an excel file\.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. Rename the exported file so that we can clearly understand the date the file was exported and the team it contains:
	1. Pattern
		1. “<YYYYMMdd><Team name>\_<AccountName>UASRoles\.xlsx”
		2. Or
		3. “<YYYYMMdd><Team name>\_<AccountName>UASRoles\.csv”
	2. Example file names:
		1. 20230620\_TcXContainer\_Acct104\_UASRoles\.xlsx
		2. 20230620\_StormOperationsOptimization\_UASRoles\.xlsx
